005package org.wpilib.math.controller;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
008import org.wpilib.math.kinematics.ChassisVelocities;
009import org.wpilib.math.linalg.DARE;
010import org.wpilib.math.linalg.MatBuilder;
011import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
012import org.wpilib.math.linalg.VecBuilder;
013import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Vector;
014import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N2;
015import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N3;
016import org.wpilib.math.system.Discretization;
017import org.wpilib.math.trajectory.HolonomicSample;
018import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
019import org.wpilib.math.util.StateSpaceUtil;
020
021/**
022 * The linear time-varying unicycle controller has a similar form to the LQR, but the model used to
023 * compute the controller gain is the nonlinear unicycle model linearized around the drivetrain's
024 * current state.
025 */
026public class LTVUnicycleController {
027  // LQR cost matrices
028  private Matrix<N3, N3> m_Q;
029  private Matrix<N2, N2> m_R;
030
031  private final double m_dt;
032
033  private Pose2d m_poseError;
034  private Pose2d m_poseTolerance;
035  private boolean m_enabled = true;
036
037  /**
038   * Constructs a linear time-varying unicycle controller with default maximum desired error
039   * tolerances of (x = 0.0625 m, y = 0.125 m, heading = 2 rad), default maximum desired control
040   * effort of (linear velocity = 1 m/s, angular velocity = 2 rad/s), and default maximum Velocity
041   * of 9 m/s.
042   *
043   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
044   */
045  public LTVUnicycleController(double dt) {
046    this(VecBuilder.fill(0.0625, 0.125, 2.0), VecBuilder.fill(1.0, 2.0), dt);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Constructs a linear time-varying unicycle controller.
051   *
052   * <p>See <a
053   * href="https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning">https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning</a>
054   * for how to select the tolerances.
055   *
056   * <p>The default maximum Velocity is 9 m/s.
057   *
058   * @param qelems The maximum desired error tolerance for each state (x, y, heading).
059   * @param relems The maximum desired control effort for each input (linear velocity, angular
060   *     velocity).
061   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
062   */
063  public LTVUnicycleController(Vector<N3> qelems, Vector<N2> relems, double dt) {
064    m_Q = StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(qelems);
065    m_R = StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(relems);
066    m_dt = dt;
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Returns true if the pose error is within tolerance of the reference.
071   *
072   * @return True if the pose error is within tolerance of the reference.
073   */
074  public boolean atReference() {
075    final var eTranslate = m_poseError.getTranslation();
076    final var eRotate = m_poseError.getRotation();
077    final var tolTranslate = m_poseTolerance.getTranslation();
078    final var tolRotate = m_poseTolerance.getRotation();
079    return Math.abs(eTranslate.getX()) < tolTranslate.getX()
080        && Math.abs(eTranslate.getY()) < tolTranslate.getY()
081        && Math.abs(eRotate.getRadians()) < tolRotate.getRadians();
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Sets the pose error which is considered tolerable for use with atReference().
086   *
087   * @param poseTolerance Pose error which is tolerable.
088   */
089  public void setTolerance(Pose2d poseTolerance) {
090    m_poseTolerance = poseTolerance;
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Returns the linear and angular velocity outputs of the LTV controller.
095   *
096   * <p>The reference pose, linear velocity, and angular velocity should come from a drivetrain
097   * trajectory.
098   *
099   * @param currentPose The current pose.
100   * @param poseRef The desired pose.
101   * @param linearVelocityRef The desired linear velocity in meters per second.
102   * @param angularVelocityRef The desired angular velocity in radians per second.
103   * @return The linear and angular velocity outputs of the LTV controller.
104   */
105  public ChassisVelocities calculate(
106      Pose2d currentPose, Pose2d poseRef, double linearVelocityRef, double angularVelocityRef) {
107    // See theorem 8.8.1 of
108    // https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf
109
110    if (!m_enabled) {
111      return new ChassisVelocities(linearVelocityRef, 0.0, angularVelocityRef);
112    }
113
114    m_poseError = poseRef.relativeTo(currentPose);
115
116    // spotless:off
117    final double τ = 20.0;
118    var A = MatBuilder.fill(Nat.N3(), Nat.N3(),
119        0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
120        0.0, -1 / τ, linearVelocityRef,
121        0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
122    var B = MatBuilder.fill(Nat.N3(), Nat.N2(),
123        1.0, 0.0,
124        0.0, 0.0,
125        0.0, 1.0);
126    // spotless:on
127
128    var discABPair = Discretization.discretizeAB(A, B, m_dt);
129    var discA = discABPair.getFirst();
130    var discB = discABPair.getSecond();
131
132    var S = DARE.dareNoPrecond(discA, discB, m_Q, m_R);
133
134    // K = (BᵀSB + R)⁻¹BᵀSA
135    var K =
136        discB
137            .transpose()
138            .times(S)
139            .times(discB)
140            .plus(m_R)
141            .solve(discB.transpose().times(S).times(discA));
142
143    var e =
144        MatBuilder.fill(
145            Nat.N3(),
146            Nat.N1(),
147            m_poseError.getX(),
148            m_poseError.getY(),
149            m_poseError.getRotation().getRadians());
150    var u = K.times(e);
151
152    return new ChassisVelocities(
153        linearVelocityRef + u.get(0, 0), 0.0, angularVelocityRef + u.get(1, 0));
154  }
155
156  /**
157   * Returns the next output of the LTV controller.
158   *
159   * <p>The reference pose, linear velocity, and angular velocity should come from a drivetrain
160   * trajectory.
161   *
162   * @param currentPose The current pose.
163   * @param desiredState The desired pose, linear velocity, and angular velocity from a trajectory.
164   * @return The linear and angular velocity outputs of the LTV controller.
165   */
166  public ChassisVelocities calculate(Pose2d currentPose, HolonomicSample desiredState) {
167    // The sample velocity is field-relative; the controller needs the
168    // robot-relative forward (linear) velocity.
169    double linearVelocity =
170        desiredState.velocity.toRobotRelative(desiredState.pose.getRotation()).vx;
171    return calculate(currentPose, desiredState.pose, linearVelocity, desiredState.velocity.omega);
172  }
173
174  /**
175   * Enables and disables the controller for troubleshooting purposes.
176   *
177   * @param enabled If the controller is enabled or not.
178   */
179  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
180    m_enabled = enabled;
181  }
182}
